derivation: of Chaldee origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified);

occurrences.text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
